title: Khaali jhoola hai
body:
jhoole mein khelne waale
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere ghuncha dahan khaali jhoola hai tera
tha ye ek maa ka sukhan khaali jhoola hai tera
<<DIVIDER>>
raas aaya nahi pardres mein jeena tujhko
dhoondti phirti hai godhon mein sakina tujhko
kaise bhoolegi behen khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhko tanhaai bohat qabr ki tadpayegi
neend jangal mein mere laal kahan aayegi
hai yehi ranj o mahan khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
beh gaye khwaab sabhi khoon ke fawware mein
asr se pehle mera chand tha gehware mein
lag gaya haye gahan khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
laut aayega to lori bhi sunaungi tujhe
apni aaghosh mein mai leke sulaungi tujhe
hogi din bhar ki thakan khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa ki aghosh se jaati nahi khushboo teri
usko tasveer nazar aati har soo teri
dil mai hoti hai chubhan khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri aghosh mein aaja ke sawarun tujhko
tu hi batlade ke kya keh ke pukarun tujhko
naazishe shaah e zaman khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
pooche mamta se ke kya hota hai aulaad ka daagh
kar diya maut ne gul dasht mein jhoole ka charagh
ab kahan koi kiran khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
garmi e qabr tujhe aab o hawa kya degi
ye kadi dhoop tujhe dasht mein jhulsa degi
phool jaisa hai badan khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi maa aamir o akhtar ye sada deti hai
apni awaaz se jhoole ko hila deti hai
aa bhi jaa jaane chaman khaali jhoola hai tera
ay mere ghuncha dahan...
author: Akhtar Sirsvi
